args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback reported rolled_out/verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before re-deploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What went wrong:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging before it was deployed.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it. The service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 says v2.3.1 failed, describes the rollback to v2.3.0 and notes that the cause needs finding before v2.3.1 is deployed again. I wrote the summary right after the rollback completed, so it doesn't include the recovered health and error-rate numbers above.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
